name: splash_portrait
prompt:
A beautiful full-screen loading splash illustration for a cozy mobile farm game about a little cute ghost who runs a farm. Vertical portrait composition. Art style exactly like the first reference image (a screenshot of the game itself): soft painted cartoon look, smooth clean dark-brown outlines with no visible pixel steps (not pixel art), warm saturated colors, gentle highlights, lush and cheerful, cozy storybook mood.

Scene: a sunny summer morning on a small cozy farm clearing in the middle of a lush forest, seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter view. The hero, in the middle of the picture: the little cute white ghost from the second reference image (soft round white body with a wavy flowing tail, big shiny dark eyes, pink blush cheeks, a happy open smile, a yellow woven straw hat with a red band), painted in the same smooth style as the first reference, floating happily a little above the ground with a soft shadow under it and a few tiny golden sparkles around it. Just behind the ghost: the cozy wooden log cabin from the game with a brown shingle roof, a stone chimney with a thin curl of smoke, small blue windows and flowers by the door; a sandy stone path leading to it; an old round stone well with a little wooden bucket; a small pond with pink water lilies, lily pads and cattails; two small garden beds with carrots, cabbages and orange pumpkins; a few sunflowers and a short wooden fence. Around the clearing, framing it: tall green spruces, round leafy oaks, a white birch, a red-orange autumn maple, a pink blossoming sakura, blue hydrangea bushes, lavender, roses and mossy grey boulders.

Layout for a phone screen (the app draws text on top of the picture): the top quarter is open soft blue sky with a few fluffy white clouds and warm sunbeams, calm and uncluttered, with treetops only at the very sides. The bottom fifth is a calm, slightly darker foreground of soft green grass with a few flowers and small pumpkins, low detail. Keep the ghost and the house inside the central 60 percent of the width: the left and right edges show only trees and foliage, because the sides get cropped on narrow phones.
